wallpaper.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual wallpaper background for a fictional desktop OS in an offline escape room, VIGIA/3 7set.dev. Create a clean 16:9 landscape desktop wallpaper only, no screenshot, no UI, absolutely no text, numbers, labels, icons, windows, taskbar or logos. Near-black #08070c, barely visible angular violet #6426c9 circuitry at the perimeter. Large subtle fragmented circular memory ring in the right half, lavender highlights very restrained, center and left dark and almost empty for app shortcuts and readable windows. Flat sophisticated purple cyber computer wallpaper, matching the approved direction, not a busy sci-fi dashboard. High quality dark texture, tasteful thin circuit paths, no bright white or cyan light. The ring is atmospheric decoration, not a data chart. 2560x1440 style wide wallpaper.
